messina-saber.prompt: RENDERING REFERENCE: the attached farm man on magenta is an APPROVED character of this game, the attached OGRE holds a club painted the way this game paints weapons, and the attached SWORD on magenta is one of this game's approved swords: match their rendering exactly (soft painterly, flat-ish colour with gentle shading, soft thick dark outlines, no texture, no background). SUBJECT: ONE ONE-HANDED CURVED SABRE in the manner of a SCIMITAR, called the MESSINA SABER, a fine Mediterranean sabre. Its HILT stands perfectly UPRIGHT and straight, on the vertical centre line of the picture, pommel at the bottom: a small rounded brass POMMEL; a GRIP long enough for ONE fist, wrapped in dark brown leather, of even thickness; a short brass CROSSGUARD, straight across, about three times as wide as the blade where it meets it, its two ends finished with small round knobs. Then the BLADE rises from the guard and CURVES clearly and smoothly to the RIGHT as it goes up, like a scimitar: a single-edged blade of bright clean steel, narrow at the guard and WIDENING toward its last third, its sharp cutting edge along the outer (right, convex) side and a thick plain back along the inner (left, concave) side, ending in a broad sweeping point that turns back up. The point ends well to the right of the hilt's centre line, about a third of the blade's length to the right. The blade is about four times as long as the grip, measured along its curve. A single thin darker line runs along the back of the blade. Colours: bright clean steel, warm brass, dark brown leather. Bold and readable: it is seen about 40 pixels tall on the board, so big plain shapes, a few strong details, no fine engraving, no glow, no sparkle, no motion lines. COLOUR: never pink, never magenta, never purple anywhere on it. Seen flat-on from the side: no tilt of the hilt, no perspective, no foreshortening. It fills most of the picture's HEIGHT, with a margin of magenta above and below. ONE WEAPON ONLY, nothing else in the picture: no hand, no sheath, no shadow, no ground, no frame, no text. Every other pixel is pure solid magenta (#FF00FF).
